disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No chain-specific revenue percentage is sourced for CIRCLE this run beyond what is quoted in placements role_evidence; see data_gaps.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenue for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL companyfacts for CIK 1876042 (Circle Internet Group, Inc., us-gaap taxonomy). This companyfacts Revenues tag jumped from 15169000 (FY2024) to 109820000 (FY2025) and is far below Circle's total reported revenue including reserve income on USDC reserves, which the company discloses separately and which this XBRL tag does not appear to capture in full; see data_gaps.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: companyfacts.fundamentals.revenue_fy for CIK 1876042 carries only three fiscal years (2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31), a 2-year span, and the tagged Revenues figure itself is unstable (see the revenue basis note above); a 3-year CAGR is not computed from this series. (canonical field revenue_cagr_3y: revenue cagr not available.)

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating income -96435000 divided by revenue 109820000 for FY2025-12-31, from companyfacts. Reflects the same narrow Revenues tag named in the revenue basis; not representative of Circle's full consolidated profitability, which includes reserve income.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 542129000 divided by net income -69508000, both FY2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 542129000 less capex 12432000, divided by revenue 109820000, FY2025-12-31, from companyfacts. The ratio exceeds 1 because the Revenues tag used as the denominator excludes reserve income that drives most of Circle's operating cash flow; see data_gaps.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: companyfacts.fundamentals.total_debt is null for CIK 1876042 even though cash (1730126000 at 2026-06-30) is reported; net debt cannot be computed without a debt figure. (canonical field net_debt_to_ebitda: net debt to ebitda not available.)

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 16382497770.0 = companyfacts diluted share count 158699000 (FY2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 103.23 of 2026-09-03 (data/market/CRCL.json quality.price_used, repo market plane).

price_to_sales.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

This ratio reads as an extreme 149x because the revenue denominator is the narrow companyfacts Revenues tag described in the revenue basis, not Circle's full reported revenue; see data_gaps and risks.

crowdedness_caveats: No pcs block exists locally for CRCL. Circle is a widely covered, recently IPO'd stablecoin issuer; this profile cannot say whether the prediction-market settlement-rail angle specifically is priced in versus Circle's much larger core USDC-issuance thesis.

catalysts.claim: Native USDC, issued by Circle's regulated affiliates and redeemable 1:1 for US dollars, is the settlement currency Polymarket is transitioning to for a consistent dollar-denominated settlement standard.
catalysts.source_name: Circle, Circle and Polymarket Partner to Strengthen Onchain Financial Markets

risks.claim: The companyfacts Revenues tag for CIK 1876042 (109820000 in FY2025) appears to exclude reserve income on USDC reserves, which Circle's own disclosures describe as its dominant revenue source; every ratio in this profile that divides by revenue (operating margin, fcf margin, price_to_sales) inherits that distortion and should not be read as Circle's true consolidated economics.
risks.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRCL.json fundamentals

data_gaps: growth.revenue_cagr_3y is NULL: only a 2-year revenue span is available and the revenue tag itself is unstable across years (see revenue basis and risks).
leverage.net_debt_to_ebitda and reverse_dcf are NULL: total_debt is not tagged.
quality.piotroski and quality.beneish_state are both PENDING_DATA.

The companyfacts Revenues tag likely excludes reserve income; every revenue-denominated ratio in this profile (operating_margin, fcf_margin, price_to_sales) should be read with that caveat, not as Circle's full consolidated economics.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the 12 canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED with official_source true is computed from SEC companyfacts. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL fields are named individually in data_gaps.
